Preserve the man's natural face, shoulder-height lateral-raise pose, charcoal tank, grey shorts/shoes, seat, background, full framing and identical two-panel layout. LEFT PANEL stays unchanged. Detailed shaded realistic anatomical illustration, clean white background, no text, no arrows, no logos, no extra limbs. The only necessary change is the raised arms being UNDER the resistant pads, not inside or above them.
